title: Learning to Focus: CSI-Free Hierarchical MARL for Reconfigurable Reflectors
abstract: arXiv:2604.05165v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) have the potential to engineer smart radio environments for next-generation millimeter-wave (mmWave) networks. However, the prohibitive computational overhead of Channel State Information (CSI) estimation and the dimensionality explosion inherent in centralized optimization severely hinder practical large-scale deployments. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce a per-element CSI-free paradigm powered by a Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (HMARL) architecture to control mechanically reconfigurable reflective surfaces. By substituting pilot-based channel estimation for each element of the device with accessible user localization data, our framework leverages spatial intelligence for macro-scale wave propagation management. translated_title: 学习聚焦：面向可重构反射器的免信道状态信息分层多智能体强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 可重构智能表面（RIS）有潜力为下一代毫米波网络构建智能无线环境。然而，信道状态信息（CSI）估计高昂的计算开销以及集中式优化中固有的维度爆炸问题严重阻碍了实际的大规模部署。为克服这些瓶颈，我们提出了一种基于分层多智能体强化学习（HMARL）架构的逐元件免CSI范式，用于控制机械可重构反射表面。通过用可获取的用户定位数据替代设备每个元件基于导频的信道估计，我们的框架利用空间智能进行宏观尺度的波传播管理。控制问题被分解为两层神经架构：高层控制器执行时间上扩展的、离散的用户到反射器的分配。
tldr: 该论文提出一种免CSI的分层多智能体强化学习（HMARL）框架，利用用户定位数据替代昂贵的信道估计来控制机械可重构反射表面，从而克服了RIS大规模部署中信道估计计算开销巨大和集中式优化维度爆炸的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a CSI-free hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning (HMARL) framework that leverages user localization data instead of costly channel estimation to control mechanically reconfigurable reflective surfaces, overcoming the prohibitive CSI estimation overhead and dimensionality explosion that hinder large-scale RIS deployments.
